_doc: Prompt template for AI-generated characters (GDD 10: realistic athletes, invented faces). {placeholders} come from the asset's 'vars' in config/assets.json. The negative part is appended to every prompt so every character stays original.
prompt: Photorealistic full-body 3D game character of an invented adult padel player, {age}, {build} athletic build, {hair}, wearing a plain {kit_colour} technical short-sleeve sports shirt, plain athletic shorts and plain court shoes, standing in a T-pose with arms straight out, neutral relaxed face, realistic skin and fabric, PBR materials, even studio lighting
negative: logo, text, letters, numbers, brand, emblem, badge, sponsor, watermark, celebrity, real person, likeness, cartoon, stylised, racket, ball, extra limbs, base, pedestal
